en.description:
Chomp your way through a classic maze arcade game — right on your wrist! Swipe (or turn the Digital Crown) to guide your hero, gobble dots, dodge ghosts, and grab power-ups to turn the tables and chase them back for a new high score.

NEW in this update:
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements — compete with friends, difficulty by difficulty
• Siri support — say "Play Watch - Dash" for a new run, or ask for your best score, hands-free
• A hand-drawn, living new look, with playful ambient touches throughout
• Digital Crown control, on top of swipe steering

Features:
Intuitive swipe and Digital Crown controls
Classic maze layout and dot-chomping gameplay
Power-up mode: turn the tables and chase the ghosts!
Easy / Normal / Fast speed picker, each with its own best score
Game Center leaderboards and achievements, plus a full on-device leaderboard — no sign-in required
Animated, colorful graphics and smooth performance
Haptic feedback for immersive play
Quick, fun sessions — perfect for on-the-go gaming

Whether you're a retro arcade fan or new to maze games, Watch - Dash is the perfect way to relive the fun, anytime, anywhere.
en.releaseNotes:
Now available in Spanish.
Improved for UK, Australian and Canadian users.
Small fixes and polish.
en.subtitle: Retro Ghost Chase + Siri Play

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Choose your speed: a new Easy / Normal / Fast picker right on the start screen.
Each speed keeps its own best score, shown under the picker and when a run ends.
Faster settings speed up the maze and the ghosts; Easy gives you slower ghosts.
Built with the latest watchOS SDK.

Watch - Dash gets a brand-new look and three real ways to play smarter:

• Game Center leaderboards and achievements, difficulty by difficulty — with a full on-device leaderboard when you're offline or signed out
• Siri support: say "Play Watch - Dash" to jump into a new run, or ask for your best score without opening the app
• Steer with a swipe or the Digital Crown — pick whichever feels best
• A hand-drawn, living redesign: sketch-style cards, a calmer new look, and ambient touches throughout
• Bigger, easier-to-tap buttons on the start screen

Thanks for playing — keep chasing that high score!
